complementary_hue_number.derivation: For source-confirmed hue positions 1-24, complementary hue is the position 12 steps opposite.

runtime_promotion_prerequisite.root_cause: The browser answer-feedback path resolved a single conventional-color colorRef before distinguishing text-only questions, so unchanged text-choice PCCS records would throw after answer submission.

same_tone.derivation: The official PCCS notation rule writes a chromatic color as tone abbreviation plus hue number; same tone is independently determined by matching the source-confirmed tone abbreviation while hue number may differ.
